manifests.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "modbus-mqtt-bridge"
version = "1.0.2"
edition = "2024"
repository = "https://github.com/open-mqtt-bridges/modbus"
homepage = "https://open-mqtt-bridges.github.io/modbus/"
license = "GPL-3.0-only"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
clap = { version = "4", features = ["derive"] }
futures = "0.3"
rumqttc = "0.25"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
serde_yaml = "0.9"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
tokio-modbus = "0.13"
tracing = "0.1"
tracing-subscriber = { version = "0.3", features = ["env-filter", "fmt", "json"] }
